notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
I have removed most all sound features to enable adding of the settings capability for muting and volume control for sound and music. I know a lot of people either don't want music playing or play their own stream music or game music. So due to the upcoming setting patch I have removed all sound for now for a re haul of the system.

I have fixed the log in and site link to obtain a oauth. later I will make this a process within the game to obtain oauth.

Stay tuned for more updates.
